notes: Copy this file to claude_dispatch_config.json and set command to your local Claude Code CLI command if auto-discovery is not enough.
The default --mode auto opens a visible terminal session in the project root.
The cli dispatcher sends the prompt through stdin and runs from the project root.
Visible terminal dispatch adds --continue by default so Claude Code keeps the latest project conversation context.
bypassPermissions and dangerously-skip-permissions are intended for trusted local training workspaces.
